name: thetacog-mcp
displayName: ThetaCog Steer: Double-Entry Bookkeeping for Autonomy
description: Flying, and it saves you tokens. How? Double-entry bookkeeping for autonomy

commands.title: Steer: Open Semantic Cockpit (3 encircled panels)
Steer: Refresh Cockpit
Steer: 📋 export — copy cockpit + spec state to the clipboard
Steer: Copy Spec State to Clipboard
Steer: Open the Spec Document
Steer: Cycle (attractor envelope — both arms, pick, re-run)
Steer: Copy the Last Envelope Card to Clipboard
Steer: Run the Loop (sensors · map · spec · chip walk)
Steer: Open the Last Steer Page (no re-run)
Steer: 📄 follow .txt — point the tail watcher + the Claude hook at the active .txt, then Steer
Steer: Check the Tail of the Steer File (amendment, not a command)
Steer: Open the Amendments Ledger
Steer: Preview the Working Tree (where would this land if committed now?)
Steer: Tick a Checklist Item (runs its acceptance first)
Steer: Refresh the Chip Walk
Steer: Refresh Both Arms
Steer: Refresh the Spec Page
Steer: Refresh the Net
Steer: Refresh the Spec Tree
Steer: Paste → Tree — arm the clipboard and fold every new row into the spec tree
Steer: 🧠 Copy Prompt Bundle — active leaf + drift zones + open invariants, with the handshake (C36)
Steer: ⚡ /clear the terminal — one click, only when the gauge says the tree holds everything
Steer: 🟢 auto-paste — arm the clipboard → steer file (every copy appends to the file open)
Steer: ⤵ Ingest Clipboard — one click: clipboard → steer file (clip stamp) → ledger row → fold; prints N new · M attached · R RELEASED
Steer: 🎙️ audio — arm the audio basin (mic → local whisper → .thetacog/audio/stream.txt → the tree on a timer)
Steer: Disarm the Audio Basin
Steer: 🔨 auto-build — dispatch the parts of what the mic hears that the walk admits (≤ 2 cycles, $20 each)
Steer: Stop Auto-Building from Audio
Steer: 🎙️ Audio Stream — open the transcript txt
Steer: Disarm the Clipboard
Steer: ⚡ Run Headless — the goal, one ephemeral worker per open unit
Steer: 🛑 Abort Worker — the headless runner's process group
Steer: ⚙️🔑 Engine & Keys — pick the worker, set its keys (SecretStorage), claim licences to this machine
Steer: 💬 Steer chat — the same chat as the 💬 pill, in the sidebar; a steer verb runs /steer, only 🌳 Fold to Tree moves text
Steer: 💬 control loop — the model the Steer chat reasons and acts with (C198 role chat; the pill's dropdown and ⚙️🔑 Engine & Keys write this one setting)
Steer: 💬 control loop — read the model the Steer chat will ask for: the picked tag, the setting, or the fallback (C198; ⚙️🔑 Engine & Keys reads it through this one door)
Steer: 🤖 subagent hands — the model a dispatched /steer worker runs on: a local tag = goose-local + that tag, claude -p = the claude preset (C201a, one door)
Steer: 💬 Use the local model instead of the default (claude -p) subagents (runner-resolver.mjs set --preset goose-local)
Steer: 💬 Use the default (claude -p) for subagents (runner-resolver.mjs set --preset claude-code-headless)
Steer: ⏵ Boot the local engine (launchctl enable + bootstrap com.thetacog.ollama)
Steer: ⏹ Halt the local engine (launchctl bootout com.thetacog.ollama)
Steer: Copy the goal in execution order
Steer: Refresh the side panel (repaint from receipts, no sensors)
Steer: Reload Window (mount the installed extension build)
Steer: 📄 View Unit Contract — the current unit's spec row, its invariants and its guard
Steer: 📎 Open a receipt the page names — data/vna, docs/specs/vna or .thetacog, inside the repo only
Steer: 🧪 Open Red Witness — the unit's guard, the file its spec row names; absent → not on disk
Steer: 🔍 Inspect Halt Reason — the halt row runner.ndjson wrote, in its own words
Steer: ☁️ Sync tape — send the signed rows the notary has not seen (one credit per witnessed commit)
Steer: 📥 Ingest Refined Goal — the clipboard through goal.mjs import --validate --install
Steer: 📋 Copy Run Summary — one line for the team, every term from a receipt
Steer: 🔏 Sign this tape (HEAD's row onto the tape under your own key — free, local, nothing leaves the machine)
Steer: 💳 Fund Autonomy Ledger (buy keys on thetadriven.com/notarise — the key lands in SecretStorage by the poll, then stamps your rows locally; nothing uploaded)
Steer: 🔗 Countersign (backup) — licence credits: bundle to .thetacog/backup/<sha>.tar.gz, then open thetadriven.com/backup?manifest=<sha>
Steer: 🔑 Connect / Buy credits (device flow on the tape's own key — login, payment and the licence happen on thetadriven.com)
Steer: 🔑 Disconnect (remove the entitlement from the secret store)
Steer: 🔑 Paste licence key — the licence by hand, the bypass under ⋮ on the ledger pill (if the vscode:// return did not open — verified before it is stored)
Steer: Auto-Amend Spec Basin (the drift is the work)
Steer: Revert Drift Changes (git restore the drifted paths)
Steer: ↗ Open the walk — the cockpit page and the walk tape (C103f: the card is a link)
Steer: 🔍 View Aperture Receipt — read-only: the spec basins that were intent, the files at the commit that were reality, κ, ω (C116)

Steer: 🔁 Recompute this receipt — re-derive it from the immutable commit + the aperture tuple; match / MISMATCH / UNMEASURED with both hashes, one pasteable line for docs/receipts/third-party-recompute.md (C241)
Steer: ↗ Open the cog ledger — data/vna/cog.ndjson and the peg
Steer: ↗ Open the runner log — .thetacog/runner.ndjson
Steer: ↗ Open the tape — the flight tape, editable never; read it
Steer: ↗ Open the steer file — the .txt the loop follows and the last research bundle
Steer: ↗ Open the tree — data/vna/spec-tree.txt

vna.chat.model.description: The ollama tag 💬 Steer chat asks for (C198: gemma for the control chat, qwen for local subagents — both settable on ⚙️🔑 Engine & Keys) until you pick one in its selector. A tag that is not installed is shown as not installed — never silently swapped for another.

vna.refreshOnSave.description: Re-run the Steer cockpit 1.5s after a save. Off by default: the pipeline walks the chip and writes shared cache, so the panel is a per-turn read-out, not a live linter.

vna.showStatusBar.description: Show the last walk's placement in the status bar. Reads data/vna/cockpit.json; shows "not run" when no walk has been run rather than a number.

vna.authBase.description: Authorization server base for the device flow (device · token · keys). Empty = https://thetadriven.com/api/auth.
